title: Anchor Protocol launches on Terra
description: Anchor Protocol launched as a Terra-based savings and lending protocol centered on UST deposits and yield generation.
notes: Launch date is based on public ecosystem documentation and should be refined if an official launch announcement is archived.

title: UST yield product becomes core Anchor use case
description: Anchor became known for UST deposits marketed around high stablecoin yields, later referenced by the SEC as paying as much as 20 percent interest.

title: TerraUSD depeg begins
description: TerraUSD began losing its intended dollar peg in May 2022, triggering a collapse in the Terra ecosystem and undermining Anchor's core UST-denominated yield product.
notes: Start date is the commonly cited market-break period; exact product impacts unfolded over several days.

title: Anchor yield product becomes economically nonfunctional after Terra collapse
description: After UST lost its peg and LUNA collapsed, Anchor's savings product no longer functioned as the advertised stablecoin yield venue that had driven its adoption.
notes: Classified as operations_ended for the yield product rather than a formal legal shutdown of a company.

title: SEC charges Terraform Labs and Do Kwon
description: The SEC charged Terraform Labs and Do Kwon, describing among other claims how UST was touted as yield-bearing through Anchor Protocol.
notes: Regulatory source establishing the Anchor yield-marketing context.
